payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (corrects the earlier update): the #GCB0DV timing probe has run (#T9PRB9), but it cannot answer this row. /api/answer's Server-Timing header has no verification stage (src/lib/server-timing.ts answerServerTimingEntries), and verification_latency_ms is recorded only while RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED is on, so repeating the probe will never show whether verification latency matters. The owner decision to leave the flag off stands. Measuring verification needs one of two things: this flag switched on (a Railway production change that needs the owner's approval), or a verification stage added to Server-Timing first. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 (Josh, 'all as recommended'): leave RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED off. Revisit after the #GCB0DV timing probe shows whether verification latency matters. PRIOR DETAIL: PR #2056 persisted verification_latency_ms behind RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED (typed, default false) with canary-absence tests. Enabling it is a Railway production env change on the Database service (explicit approval; rollback = set false), gated on a dashboard consumer existing. Do not enable speculatively; do not add unproven fields.
